correctness.rationale: The defining integer sum of termwise parities is exactly the transform of (1,1,0) in Rampersad–Wiebe, journal Theorem 15 (arXiv v1 Theorem 18), so the support rejects precisely runs of length 2 mod 3, with the empty product accepted. Fixed-width binary order is increasing integer order; leading zeros in the initial state do not matter. From unfinished-run residues 0,1,2, reading zero resets states 0/1 and rejects 2, while a one advances cyclically, with final acceptance in 0/1. This proves the three prefix decompositions including A₀=B₀={0}, C₀ empty. The top accepted integer of A_m is 2^m−1 except when m≡2 mod 3, when clearing the last bit gives the maximum 2^m−2. The first element of B_m is zero, and the first of C_m is 2^{m−1} for m≥1. Consequently the only inter-block gaps are u_L=1+1_{L≡0 mod 3} for A_L and v_L=2^{L−2}+1+1_{L≡0 mod 3} for B_L, the latter only for L≥2. For L≥3 elimination gives the three preceding A-multisets plus u_L and v_{L−1}, with initial A-multisets empty, one gap 1, and two gaps 1. At L=3 both impulses are gap 2; thereafter the second impulse is exactly g_{L−3}. This proves all three generating functions, strict first appearance at depth j+3 for g_j, and exclusion of every other gap. The size series is (1+z)/D. In |z|≤q the triangle inequality on z+z²+z³, including its equality case, rules out any root of D but q; D′(q)<0. Taking ratios of simple-pole coefficients therefore gives the displayed fixed-gap limiting shares. Summing their numerators, including the geometric tail, gives 1+q at z=q using D(q)=0. Since q>1/2, summing g_jπ(g_j) diverges. The limit is for initial dyadic blocks, not arbitrary cutoffs. A separately written check verified exact binomial sums at n=0,…,300 (each 0 or 1) and all 121,395 adjacent pairs across L=1,…,18, with largest gap 32,769; those checks corroborate but do not replace the recurrence and pole proofs.
correctness.replay: Run python3 independent_gap_check.py in the separate reproduction directory; the adjacent independent_gap_check_output.txt records the exact integer and gap tests.
residual_risks: Only the distribution along dyadic prefixes is established. The manuscript's original checker enumerates every start state, but only state 0 is directly asserted against a separate predicate in that routine; the all-state recurrence is supported by the written transitions, not by a claim of fuller finite checking.

value.rationale: The gap statistic is a natural geometric refinement of a published automatic support: it gives all possible distances, their multiplicities at every dyadic depth and a normalized limiting law with infinite mean. Membership and one-point support size do not answer those questions. The lacunary gap sizes and explicit asymptotic frequencies explain a nontrivial distinction between typical gaps and mean spacing without claiming a new underlying sequence.
residual_risks: The quantitative interpretation concerns dyadic prefixes of this fixed support only.
